timing_definitions.train_seconds: All epochs: DataLoader iteration (incl. CPU transforms), host->device copies (no-op on CPU), forward/backward/step. Excludes dataset loading and model construction. Device synchronized at start and end (no-op on CPU).
timing_definitions.inference_seconds: Full pass over the test set: DataLoader iteration, host->device copies, forward, argmax. Excludes copying predictions to CPU and accuracy computation. Device synchronized at start and end (no-op on CPU).

warmup_methodology: Both CPU (Q2) and GPU (Q1) runs are preceded by the same untimed warm-up: N training batches plus N test-mode forward passes on a throw-away model instance, before seeding. On the GPU it absorbs one-time kernel compilation/autotuning and device context set-up; on the CPU there is no kernel compilation, so it only absorbs first-call overheads (memory allocator growth, oneDNN primitive creation, thread-pool start-up). Timed regions are identical; device synchronization is a no-op on the CPU because CPU operators execute synchronously.
